messages:
nina: Post-launch check: we shipped the streaming prompts tweak in launch wave. Three follow-on asks popped up: enterprise vector drift (major customer), experiment causing p99 tail latency, and a small token-count tooltip design ask. Need to prioritize for next micro-sprint.

dave: Can you paste the vector drift ticket? Is it consistently reproducible?

lee: Ticket EVT-91: customer reports search recall degrading over last 48h, appears correlated with our nightly compaction job. They9re seeing stale vectors occasionally.

tara: Infra note: compaction job has a new parallelism change (rolled at 02:00 UTC) that could race with KV writes. Observed a few "write_after_compact" warnings.

anu: Tooltip is one-screen, low effort. Will do a quick spec. Good for CS visibility.

nina: My recommendation: treat EVT-91 as P0/P1 (customer-blocking) — rollback the compaction parallelism and hotfix vector reconcile. Experiment rollout for streaming prompts -> pause to investigate p99 if tied to batching. Token tooltip -> defer to next sprint unless we have spare cycles.

dave: I can do a revert of compaction parallelism and add a reconciliation pass that reindexes affected keys. Estimate 1.5 dev days + testing. Need SRE for coordinated rollback.

tara: I9ll schedule a rolling revert and prepare a staging job to simulate heavy writes. Also run a short reconciliation job on staging to validate.

ci-bot: CI passed for revert branch: revert/compaction-parallelism-1780009999. (automated)

nina: Decision: EVT-91 = hotfix (owners dave + tara). Streaming prompts experiment = pause and triage P2 (owner dave). Token tooltip = P3 (anu). Follow-up: release window tonight for canary rollback 10pm UTC.

lee: Success criteria for EVT-91 hotfix: customer search recall returns to baseline in 24h, no stale vector alerts, and compaction job shows zero "write_after_compact" warnings for 48h.

dave: Opening PR for revert and reconcile script. I9ll include a small smoke test that replays the customer9s failing trace.

tara: After revert canary, I9ll run a load replay and capture p99/p95 for chat endpoints to ensure the experiment pause didn9t mask other regressions.

anu: I9ll draft the tooltip and attach a screenshot to the ticket for visibility. If we get spare capacity, I can land it quickly.

nina: Notes for roadmap: slotging experiment triage in next-day deep-dive; hotfix has immediate runway. Sync 9am PT tomorrow to confirm canary results. :eyes:

dave: :thumbsup:
